description.value: Pho Mr. Do is a family-owned Vietnamese restaurant on East Hastings Street in Burnaby, serving authentic pho and Vietnamese dishes prepared from scratch with fresh produce. The menu spans an extensive selection of rice noodle soups, vermicelli dishes, and appetizers, making it a substantial refueling stop for hungry cyclists. Vegan and vegetarian options are well-represented throughout the menu, and takeout and delivery are both available.
